# External R results for the autoArima acceptance gates

Output of R `forecast::auto.arima`, `urca::ur.kpss`, `forecast::ndiffs`,
`mstl` and `nsdiffs`, run as an **external tool** in the
`rocker/r-ver:4.4.1` Docker image on the series exported by
`tool/auto_arima_synthetic_study.dart --export` (synthetic, 2200 series) and
`tool/auto_arima_rolling_windows.dart --export` (60 rolling-origin windows of
the reference series). Only the numeric output is stored; no GPL source is
part of this package. The exact commands are in each `PROVENANCE.txt` and
`run.R`; the input series are regenerated by the exporters from fixed seeds.

`comparison_report.md` in each folder is the output of
`tool/auto_arima_r_compare.dart` for that run (spec gates C-d', C-S', MASE
against R, D').
